name: weather-for-grown-ups
description: Unified agent-native access to NOAA GFS/GEFS, ECMWF IFS/IFS ENS, and historical GFS analysis.

scripts.test:smoke: node dist/entry.js --help && node dist/cli.js --help && node dist/cli.js catalog --help && node dist/cli.js catalog --search cloud --sections fields --classification raw --limit 3 --json && node dist/cli.js query --help && node dist/cli.js diagnose --help && node dist/cli.js compare-runs --help && node dist/cli.js compare-datasets --help && node dist/cli.js verify --help && node dist/cli.js analogs --help && node dist/cli.js index --help
scripts.test:live:gfs-equivalence: npm run test:live:gfs-operational-parity && npm run test:live:gfs-archive-equivalence
scripts.test:live:gefs: tsx scripts/live-smoke-gefs.ts && tsx scripts/live-smoke-gefs-points-timeseries.ts && tsx scripts/live-smoke-gefs-points-bundle-timeseries.ts && tsx scripts/live-smoke-gefs-transect.ts
scripts.test:live:all: npm run test:live:bundled && npm run test:live:s3 && npm run test:live:history && npm run test:live:gfs-equivalence && npm run test:live:ifs && npm run test:live:gefs && npm run test:live:gefs-reforecast && npm run test:live:gefs-runs && npm run test:live:area && npm run test:live:igra && npm run test:live:igra-skill
